historical_pattern: Accepted splits/states had features that could be recognized repeatedly even when the feature was clinical rather than molecular.
negative_control_test: Schizophrenia and SCLC over-subtypes failed partly because subtype assignment was unstable or poorly reproducible.

historical_pattern: Successful scientific splits were reproduced across investigators/settings and often strengthened after external replication.
negative_control_test: Authority or multiple publications without independent cohorts can preserve a weak split, as illustrated historically by presenile/senile dementia and classification inertia.

candidate: Boundary robustness to measurement conditions and arbitrary thresholds
historical_pattern: Successful categorical entities had boundaries not wholly created by assay conditions or arbitrary cut-points; continuous entities were better represented dimensionally.
negative_control_test: Low-renin hypertension classification changed with assay/population/sodium context; old autism/schizophrenia boundaries showed overlap/instability.

candidate: Temporal coherence appropriate to the claimed class
historical_pattern: Distinct diseases/subtypes can precede treatment; stages emerge longitudinally; treatment-resistance states require prior exposure.
negative_control_test: Applying a pretreatment-disease standard to CRPC or DRE would be category error; conversely post-treatment biology cannot prove a pre-existing distinct disease.

historical_pattern: Strong splits were not explained solely by severity, duration, treatment exposure, comorbidity, measurement or context.
negative_control_test: Failed/partial splits were often explainable by state, measurement context or arbitrary age/symptom boundaries.

historical_pattern: Distinct agents/diseases often differed in course; stage definitions require transitions; treatment states predict future course/management.
negative_control_test: Schizophrenia subtypes and presenile/senile dementia lacked sufficiently distinctive stable longitudinal behavior.

historical_pattern: Many accepted classifications changed prevention, testing, treatment, prognosis or trial design.
negative_control_test: Useful operational categories such as MS phenotypes show that utility can exist without separate biology; therefore utility alone cannot establish ontology.

candidate: Intrinsic etiologic, pathological, genetic or stable mechanistic distinction
historical_pattern: Viral hepatitis, HIV-1/2, primary aldosteronism, CML/GIST and diabetes gained strong disease-level support from intrinsic causes/mechanisms.
negative_control_test: Age, symptom dominance or assay-defined state without intrinsic coherence did not survive as separate disease ontology.

historical_pattern: Strong in hepatitis, CML, GIST, APL, HER2 and primary aldosteronism.
negative_control_test: Not necessary for a clinically useful stage/state (MS, DRE), so cannot be universal.

historical_pattern: HER2/APL/T2 asthma show a coherent biological pathway that can cut within a broader syndrome.
negative_control_test: A biomarker without stable pathway coherence or external validation should remain exploratory.

candidate: Treatment-by-subgroup interaction or mechanism-linked therapeutic response
historical_pattern: APL, HER2, GIST and T2 asthma gained major credibility when targeted intervention benefit matched the proposed biology.
negative_control_test: Treatment response alone can also define a state and can be confounded; it is not sufficient by itself for separate disease ontology.

historical_pattern: MS and CRPC are meaningful because the classification describes course/time; movement between states is expected rather than a validity failure.
negative_control_test: Demanding immutable membership would incorrectly reject genuine stages.

candidate: Standardized adequate treatment exposure before resistance is assigned
historical_pattern: DRE explicitly requires adequate tolerated appropriately chosen/used regimens; CRPC requires progression despite castrate testosterone; MDR-TB uses drug-susceptibility evidence.
negative_control_test: Without adequate exposure, pseudo-resistance and treatment-system failure can masquerade as resistance.

historical_pattern: TB demonstrates that resistance can be selected by treatment quality and transmitted; epilepsy definition requires adequate use.
negative_control_test: A treatment-failure label without exposure verification has weak mechanistic meaning.

candidate: Reliability plus clinical/research utility despite absent biological separator
historical_pattern: MS phenotypes demonstrate that a useful standardized category can be legitimate for trials/prognosis without constituting separate diseases.
negative_control_test: Regulatory or expert adoption alone must not be upgraded to biological ontology.

historical_pattern: Common in MS, DRE, cancer subtypes and diagnostic systems.
negative_control_test: Schizophrenia/Alzheimer examples show that consensus/authority can preserve weak classifications.

historical_pattern: Long persistence can reflect use or inertia.
negative_control_test: Traditional schizophrenia subtypes and presenile/senile dementia persisted despite weak validity.

candidate: War, political stability and national/global economic conditions
historical_pattern: WWII accelerated hepatitis research; Cultural Revolution suppressed/delayed APL work; funding environments altered opportunity.
negative_control_test: These factors explain discovery/adoption timing but cannot establish that entities are biologically distinct.

candidate: Research funding, institutional capacity and technology availability
historical_pattern: Diabetes programs, cytogenetics, endoscopy, omics and molecular pathology repeatedly enabled discoveries.
negative_control_test: A technology can reveal either a true entity (CML) or a misleading apparent subgroup (low-renin hypertension).

candidate: Commercial incentive, reimbursement, advocacy or regulatory pathway
historical_pattern: HER2/GIST translation illustrates strong acceleration of clinically actionable classification.
negative_control_test: Commercial/regulatory success can follow true biology but is not evidence of ontology itself.

historical_pattern: Explicitly implicated in presenile/senile Alzheimer distinction and classification persistence.
negative_control_test: Can promote invalid categories; therefore cannot be a scientific criterion.
